response.original_title: Thus the Dream Burst - 呸，讲了破掉
response.overview: After a girl passes away into the afterlife, she is beckoned by death to have a conversation. To relief a superstitious tradition, she walks death through multiple dreams that have been haunting her. This film centers around death, the avoidance and the acceptance.
response.tagline: We do our best, we live our days, and then we die.
response.title: Thus the Dream Burst - 呸，讲了破掉
